results.title: Occupational Therapist
results.description:

results.title: Funeral Assistant - Driver (A22059)
results.description:
Working location: Gambas Crescent

Working hours: 8am to 6pm (every 5 days off 1 day)

Salary: $2500 + VB + Year End bonus + Sales bonuses (Gross salary: $3000 to $4000 on average)

Weekends and PH standby out of office if on shift

JOB DESCRIPTION

  • Collection and transportation of deceased
  • Preparation of coffin and encoffining
  • Loading and unloading of heavy items / coffins
  • Performing a variety of tasks during the funeral process, such as providing assistance during funeral rites, closing of casket, guiding the bereaved family etc.
  • Driving of funeral hearse
  • Assist funeral advisors during the funeral process to ensure smooth proceedings
  • Maintaining tidiness of company vehicles and premises
  • Other ad hoc tasks as required

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Possess Class 3 / 3A driving license
  • Able to lift heavy weight (up to 25kg) and perform physical work
  • Computer literate
  • Able to do shift work and work overtime when needed
  • Candidates should be comfortable with holding joss sticks, close contact with the deceased etc.
  • Ability to show compassion when dealing with bereaved families

results.title: SAP Employee Central Payroll (EC Payroll) Consultant
results.description:
About Us:
From business process re-engineering to global business expansion for Japanese corporations, Abeam Consulting has served our clients through more than 40 years of growth. With our vision of being the No. 1 global consulting firm from Asia, ABeam Consulting helps our clients take on the challenge of business transformation. With 4,400 consultants in Japan, and 3,100 in overseas offices concentrated in Asia, our 7,500 consultants and global alliance partners provide truly comprehensive services.

Position Overview:

We are seeking an experienced SAP Employee Central Payroll (EC Payroll) Consultant / Solution Architect to lead and deliver multi-country payroll implementations. This role goes beyond configuration—it requires end-to-end solution ownership, client-facing leadership, coordination of offshore teams, people management, and support in pre-sales initiatives.

You will play a key role in shaping payroll solutions, ensuring best practices, mentoring consultants, and enabling client success across multiple projects.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Lead and participate in the implementation of SAP EC Payroll for clients.
  • Conduct thorough business process analysis to understand client needs and map them to the EC Payroll system.
  • Configure EC Payroll settings for payroll elements, deductions, and statutory contributions.
  • Integrate EC Payroll with SAP SuccessFactors, S/4HANA, and other HR/finance systems.
  • Develop and maintain test plans; conduct end-to-end payroll testing to ensure accuracy.
  • Provide knowledge transfer and training to client HR/Payroll teams.
  • Stay up to date on the latest SAP EC Payroll functionalities and legislative changes in Singapore and China.
  • Document processes and procedures for system support and handover.

Expanded Solution Architect Responsibilities:

  • Multi-Project Leadership: Oversee multiple payroll implementation projects in Singapore and across the region, ensuring consistency and quality of delivery.
  • Client Engagement: Act as the key functional advisor and trusted partner to client HR and IT leadership, managing expectations and addressing escalations.
  • Offshore Team Coordination: Guide and coordinate offshore payroll consultants and technical teams to ensure seamless execution and timely delivery.
  • People Management:
  • Lead a team of payroll consultants, managing performance, growth, and career progression.
  • Ensure training, certification, and continuous learning opportunities are available.
  • Act as a mentor and empathetic leader, fostering a collaborative and supportive team culture.
  • Solution Design & Quality Assurance: Review solution design and configuration delivered by consultants to ensure compliance with best practices, statutory requirements, and project scope.
  • Pre-Sales & Business Development:
  • Contribute to proposals, RFPs, and client presentations.
  • Provide thought leadership in payroll transformation discussions with prospects.
  • Identify opportunities to upsell value-added payroll solutions.
  • Innovation & Best Practices: Drive adoption of automation, tools, and accelerators to improve payroll efficiency and project quality.

Requirements:

  • Minimum 10 years’ proven experience as an SAP EC Payroll Consultant, with at least 2 years in a Solution Architect or Lead role.
  • Strong understanding of payroll processes and statutory compliance in Singapore (China knowledge preferred).
  • Hands-on experience in SAP EC Payroll configuration and integration.
  • Experience working in consulting environments with multiple client engagements.
  • Strong leadership, mentoring, and people management skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills in English; Mandarin proficiency advantageous to liaise with stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously under tight timelines.
  • SAP Payroll or SAP SuccessFactors certification is a plus.
  • Experience with SAP HCM Payroll (on-premise) and other HR modules is a plus.
  • Exposure to project management methodologies (e.g., SAP Activate) is a plus.
  • Pre-sales or solutioning experience in HR technology projects is a plus.

Why Join Us
At ABeam Consulting, we place a strong emphasis on collaboration, and helping our employees grow and develop their skills, offering a supportive and empowering work environment. With a presence in multiple countries and a diverse range of clients, Abeam Consulting offers an exciting and dynamic workplace for individuals looking to build a career in consulting. Abeam Consulting has also recently joined SAP’s regional strategic partner initiative as their first regional partner in the region and has also been recognized by UiPath as a Diamond Partner in providing RPA solutions. With such accolades, we aim to continue driving enterprise and digital transformation initiatives in order to transform the way people work and communicate in the digital age. In addition, our industry team is working tirelessly in order to bring more solutions to the banking and finance sector.

We regret only shortlisted candidates will be notified.
